# Diffle attribution

mdiff incorporates Diffle 0.3.6 from [moritzwilksch/diffle](https://github.com/moritzwilksch/diffle), commit `bc1cb5a13203a71f675542506120ea76afeab098`.

Copyright 2026 Moritz Wilksch. The original source remains under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE); its dependency notices are retained in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

mdiff adds a native Tauri runtime and IPC transport, GitLab integration, desktop configuration, appearance settings, responsive layouts, and independent branding. mdiff as a whole is distributed under GPL-3.0-only. This is an independent project, not an official Diffle distribution.
